description: Set up project environment, install dependencies, verify baseline build, and configure Next.js for the Riot API integration.
steps: Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22' to ensure Node.js is available, then 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && npm install' to install existing dependencies and verify they work.
Run 'npm run build' to confirm the baseline project builds successfully.
Run 'npm run lint' to confirm no lint errors exist.
No additional packages are needed - use the native fetch API (available in Node.js 22) for Riot API requests instead of axios.
Create a .env.local file with placeholder RIOT_API_KEY=RGAPI-xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx. Ensure .env.local is in .gitignore (it should be by default in Next.js).
Create a .env.example file documenting the required RIOT_API_KEY variable (without a real value) so collaborators know what's needed.
Update next.config.ts to add images.remotePatterns for ddragon.leagueoflegends.com (the Riot Data Dragon CDN that serves champion icons/images).
Verify the build still passes after config changes with 'npm run build'.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint completes without errors
next.config.ts has images.remotePatterns configured for ddragon.leagueoflegends.com
